OUR STORY

A personal commitment.
A shared journey.

Founded by Faith Sheba Gamde, Fit is Lit is built around movement, confidence and the everyday commitment to keep going.

Our focus is simple: help you find a starting point that makes sense for you. Explore prerecorded Weight Gain and Weight Loss classes, alongside nutrition guides for everyday food choices.

Make space for your goals. Find your rhythm. Keep moving forward.
